record.issue_text: Weakened embed_controller_spec 'missing host' test passes for the wrong reason: it fabricates no host but also doesn't stub a referer, so it fails via the nil-referer path instead of the no-hosts path and can't distinguish the two conditions

adjudication.rationale: In `spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb`, the "raises an error with a missing host" test no longer sets up a "no hosts configured" condition (it removed `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts = nil`) and also does not stub `request.referer`. With the code change in `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` (now only `raise ... unless EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)`), the request will fail because `request.referer` is nil/invalid (since `URI(nil)` is rescued to nil in `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host`), not specifically because there are no allowed host records. This makes the test pass for a less specific reason and it cannot distinguish "no allowed hosts" from "missing/invalid referer" after the refactor.
